keyframe_review.note: New keyframe. The British evacuated "the internal regions of Somaliland" "between March and April 1910" (Somaliland campaign page), leaving "the interior regions in the hands of the Dervishes" (Dervish state page); on 9 August 1913 a Dervish column clashed with "the only remaining British mobile force in the colony" at Dul Madoba. [Reviewer af-01-x, 2026-10-18: start moved from 1913 to 1910.]

ledger.note: 1899: the Dervish movement of Mohammed Abdullah Hassan begins at Taleh. Infobox "1899-1920"; "headquartered in Taleh between 1899 and 1920"; another passage gives "1896/1900-1921". The first dated act on the pages is March 1900, an attack on an Ethiopian outpost near Jijiga.

ledger.note: 1903: the Dervishes hold the Nugaal Valley from Halin to Eyl. The page puts the British withdrawal ("By the end of June, the withdrawal was complete") in 1903 and says the Dervish "had occupied" the valley; it does not name its previous holder (the Illig treaty later has it "ceded").

ledger.note: 5 March 1905: the Treaty of Illig cedes the Nugaal Valley. "the Dervishes were ceded the Nugaal Valley", with an Italian subsidy and "autonomous protected status"; the campaign page dates the Ilig or Pestalozza agreement 5 March 1905.

ledger.note: March-April 1910: the British evacuate the interior and the Dervishes hold it. Somaliland campaign page: "the British government ordered the evacuation of the internal regions of Somaliland" "between March and April 1910"; the Dervish state page: the British "retreated to the few remaining coastal regions", leaving "the interior regions in the hands of the Dervishes". [Reviewer af-01-x, 2026-10-18: year moved from 1913 to 1910 on the campaign page.]

[Reviewer af-01-x, 2026-10-18: note corrected; the withdrawal year 1910 is on the campaign page.]

ledger.note: February 1920: the Dervish state ends at Taleh. "His death in 1921 due to either malaria or influenza ended the Dervish movement" (Dervish state page); the campaign page has Abdullah Hassan die 21 December 1920 "(the precise date is unclear)". The end date is my reading: the pages disagree on when the movement ended (Taleh in February 1920, the Mullah's death 21 December 1920 or in 1921).

Taleh, the Dervish headquarters, given as a coordinate (the gazetteer lacks the name)

wars.outcome: British victory in 1920: the Taleh forts fell and the Dervish movement ended with the Mullah's death; in between the Nugaal Valley was ceded to the Dervishes under Italian protection (Illig, 5 March 1905) and the British withdrew to the coast.
wars.note: Dated actions on the pages: March 1900 (attacks on caravans from Harar into the Ogaden; an Ethiopian outpost near Jijiga), spring 1901 (joint British-Ethiopian expedition), 6 October 1902 (Erigo), April 1903 (Gumburu), 9-10 January 1904 (Jidali), 9 August 1913 (Dul Madoba), 9 February 1920 (Taleh). Ethiopian control of the Haud was nominal.

certainty.note: Nomadic, no frontier lines; only the Nugaal Valley is a named cession (1905).

sources.title: Dervish state
sources.note: Infobox 1899-1920, Taleh headquarters, Nugaal Valley ceded at Illig 1905, Eyl 1905-1909, British Somaliland 1908, withdrawal to the coast and Taleh 1913, February 1920. No area.

sources.title: Somaliland campaign
sources.note: Dated campaigns: March 1900, 1901 expedition, Nugal Valley held from Halin to Eyl (1903), Illig Treaty 5 March 1905, Dul Madoba 9 Aug 1913, Taleh 9 February 1920, death 21 December 1920.

notes:
New dossier: Cliopatria has no Dervish row. Pages opened: Dervish state, Somaliland campaign (2). Disagreements: the Dervish state page gives 1899-1920 in the infobox and 1896/1900-1921 elsewhere; Hassan died in 1921 (Dervish page) or on 21 December 1920 (campaign page); the Dervish page puts Dul Madooba in 1905-1910, the campaign page on 9 August 1913. Not on the pages: the extent of Dervish-held land in the Haud and Sool, and any Ethiopian-side border; the Illig treaty gave the Nugaal Valley to the Dervishes under Italian 'autonomous protected status' (a vassal relation of italian-africa: the Italian dossier could record vassal_start/vassal_end for 'dervish-state').
Counterparts: british-africa (Cliopatria row, which includes British Somaliland), italian-africa (includes Italian Somaliland), ethiopian-empire. Gazetteer names needed: Taleh (the Dervish headquarters in northern Somalia; the coordinate used, 8.42 N 47.28 E, is approximate and should be replaced by the gazetteer agent's), Halin, Illig (Ilig, a place on the Indian Ocean coast of Somalia where the 1905 treaty was signed). [Reviewer af-01-x, 2026-10-18: the British evacuation of the interior is dated March-April 1910 on the Somaliland campaign page; the interior gain and the 1910 keyframe now use it.]
